tasks.brief: Develop a fuzzy Starlight product idea into a reviewable proposal covering users, scenario, value, workflow, rules, boundaries, reliability, and acceptance criteria.
Decide where a supplied product passage belongs in the knowledge base and produce a minimal write plan without executing a real write.
Review a teacher-facing feature proposal, identifying ineffective wording, critical gaps, and decisions that belong to Yi.

review_order: Randomize A and B labels before presenting outputs to Yi.
promotion_policy: One result cannot promote or rewrite a confirmed rule.
